links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM answers across repeated test rounds two weeks apart
links.effect: Reproducibility 81.6% (κ = 0.556) for GPT-3.5 vs 76.7% (κ = 0.364) for OpenAI o3; o3 accuracy fell from 83.3% to 70.0% across rounds.
links.quote: Over two test rounds, GPT-3.5's accuracy remained stable, whereas OpenAI o3's accuracy decreased from 83.3% to 70.0%, indicating some variability.

links.outcome: Standalone AI accuracy compared with clinical pharmacists on pharmacy MCQs
links.effect: OpenAI o3 accuracy 83.3% vs GPT-3.5 70.0% and pharmacists 69.7%; AI performance declined significantly with increasing question difficulty.
links.quote: OpenAI o3 achieved the highest accuracy (83.3%), sensitivity (90.0%), and specificity (70.0%), outperforming GPT-3.5 (70.0%, 77.5%, 55.0%) and pharmacists (69.7%, 77.0%, 55.0%).

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark comparing GPT-3.5 and OpenAI o3 against clinical pharmacists on a set of 60 multiple-choice questions without testing specific deployment safeguards.
